1.title: Republican Groups Rush to Paxton’s Aid in Texas After Staying on Sidelines
1.summary: An organization allied with Senate G.O.P. leaders has booked more than $51 million in ads. Now, Ken Paxton has a financial edge after months of being outspent by his Democratic rival.

2.title: What a Hunchbacked Raccoon Teaches Us About Kindness in a Fractured World
2.summary: A neckless raccoon named Jimothy captivated the internet, and sent this Seattle resident out looking.

3.title: As Millions of Birds Migrate, Residents Are Asked to Turn Off the Lights
3.summary: Birds are drawn to lights, and more than a billion die each year after crashing into buildings, experts said.

4.title: French officials investigate if malicious act caused train derailment
4.summary: Officials say a rail fragment was found on the tracks after Friday's crash of a passenger train that left 44 people injured.

5.title: Trump Says Irish Unification Would Be ‘Fantastic,’ Breaking With Precedent
5.summary: The United States is officially neutral on an issue that had been a source of decades of violence in Northern Ireland until a 1998 peace deal.

6.title: In Doonbeg, Trump’s Irish Open Visit Prompts Protests and Praise
6.summary: As the U.S. president heads to his Doonbeg hotel for the Irish Open, locals expressed both appreciation for the resort’s economic benefits and opposition to his politics.
